description:
We don’t just look at the stars—we code for them. 🚀

We are Oribt Architect, a high-powered crew of hackers, designers, and space enthusiasts crashing into the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Armed with coffee, curiosity, and NASA’s open-source data, we are tackling Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars. Our mission? To turn complex cosmic data into a sleek, game-changing solution that leaves a mark on Earth and beyond. Fasten your seatbelts
